title: The Missing Person
briefing_md:
Ananya Desai, lead actress of the college drama society, vanished on Friday night, 20 hours before the final show of “Midnight in Jaipur”.

Rehearsal ended at 9:00 PM. A note on her dressing-room mirror says she left on her own. Her friends do not believe it.

Three people are being talked about:
• Dev Malhotra, 23, the stage manager and Ananya's ex. He argued with her on Thursday.
• Kavya Nair, 21, the understudy. She says she left around 8:45 PM and has not spoken to Ananya since rehearsal.
• Mr. Sandeep Rao, 50, the director. He scolded Ananya in front of everyone last week.

Most people suspect Dev. What happened to Ananya, where is she, and who is responsible?

clue.label: Her bag
clue.title: Left in the dressing room
clue.text: Ananya's bag is still in the dressing room. Inside: her wallet, hostel ID, room keys and phone charger.

questions.question: What does the bag tell us?
options: She planned her trip very carefully
She probably did not leave on her own
She went back to her hostel room
She was robbed in the dressing room

clue.label: Mirror note
clue.title: The note and her notebook
clue.text:
• The note on the mirror is written with a blue gel pen.
• Ananya's notebook is written with a black fountain pen from the first page to the last.

questions.question: What does this suggest?
options: She changed pens to hide her handwriting
The note is older than the notebook
Someone else probably wrote the note
Nothing, because pens run out all the time

clue.label: Spelling
clue.title: Read the note closely
clue.text:
The note says: “I can't do this anymore. I will definately not be back. Don't look for me.”

In Ananya's notebook the spelling is correct everywhere. She writes “definitely” correctly, twice.

questions.question: What does the spelling tell us?
options: Ananya wrote the note in a great hurry
The note is a line taken from the play
Ananya cannot spell long words
The writer makes a mistake Ananya does not

clue.label: Light console
clue.title: Where was Dev?
clue.text:
• Stage crew: “Dev was at the light console, in full view of all of us, from 9:00 to 10:30.”
• Ananya's phone shows 3 missed calls from Dev between 9:20 and 9:35 PM.
• Dev raised the alarm at 10:00 PM.

questions.question: What does this tell us about Dev?
options: He stayed in view and was trying to find her
He took her away from campus at 9:20 PM
He wrote the note while at the console
He left the campus as soon as rehearsal ended

clue.label: Old poster
clue.title: Backstage wall
clue.text: A poster of last year's show still hangs backstage. It shows Dev and Ananya together; they were a couple then. They argued on Thursday.

questions.question: What does the poster prove?
options: It proves that Dev is responsible
A reason to suspect Dev, but not proof
It proves Ananya left because of Dev
It proves that Dev wrote the note

clue.label: Gate register
clue.title: The director
clue.text:
• Main gate register: the director's car went out at 9:15 PM.
• The director: “If Ananya cannot perform, my final show is in trouble. I need her on that stage.”

questions.question: Why is the director an unlikely suspect?
options: He was at the light console with Dev all evening
He has never met Ananya outside rehearsals
He left at 9:15, and losing her hurts his show
He does not have a key to any room

clue.label: Understudy
clue.title: Who gains?
clue.text: The director: “Kavya wants the lead badly. If Ananya cannot perform tomorrow, the role goes to her.”

questions.question: Who gains most if Ananya misses the show?
options: Dev
The director
The janitor
Kavya

clue.label: Janitor
clue.title: Mr. Pillai's statement
clue.text: “Around 9:40 PM I heard faint knocking from the basement. I thought it was the pipes.”

questions.question: What could the knocking mean?
options: Someone may be shut in down in the basement
The water pipes are certainly broken
Dev was repairing the stage lights
The final show had already started

twist_md: New evidence has come in: Ananya's phone has been unlocked, and the stage key board and the gate register have been checked.

clue.label: Her phone
clue.title: Last message received
clue.text:
9:08 PM, from Kavya:
“Your cloak got moved to the old store room. Come, I'll open it.”

Kavya's statement: “I left around 8:45 PM. I haven't spoken to Ananya since rehearsal.”
Main gate register: Kavya Nair — OUT 10:20 PM.

twist_questions.question: What does this show?
options: Kavya told the truth about leaving at 8:45 PM
Dev sent that message using Kavya's phone
Kavya lied, and she called Ananya to the store room
Ananya had her cloak with her all evening

clue.label: Key board
clue.title: Keys and the basement door
clue.text:
• On the stage key board, the tag for B-07 (the old costume store room in the basement) is missing.
• Door B-07 has old rusted hinges, but a brand-new shiny padlock.

twist_questions.question: Where is Ananya most likely to be?
options: At her parents' home
Locked inside store room B-07
In the college library
At the railway station

clue.label: Kavya's script
clue.title: Notes in the margin
clue.text:
Kavya's copy of the script has notes in blue gel pen.
In one note she writes: “definately louder here”.

twist_questions.question: Who wrote the note on the mirror?
options: Ananya
Dev
The director
Kavya

answer.explanation: Kavya Nair, the understudy, lured Ananya to the old costume store room B-07 with a message at 9:08 PM, locked her in with a new padlock and wrote a fake goodbye note on the mirror. The note is in Kavya's blue gel pen with her spelling mistake “definately”; Ananya uses a black fountain pen and spells the word correctly. Ananya's wallet, ID, keys and charger were left behind, and the janitor heard knocking from the basement at 9:40. Kavya said she left at 8:45, but the gate register shows 10:20. If Ananya cannot perform, the lead goes to Kavya. Dev was at the light console in view of the crew and kept calling her; the director left at 9:15. Ananya is found safe in B-07.
